title: 📊 Daily Report: Fri Nov 6, 2026
text:
The swing book closed at $17,827.86. For the week it's down $771.95 against Monday's base: the strategies are down $60.84 and CORE QQQ is down $711.11. Since the merge the book is down 10.95% ($2,192.88), while Indy (the SPY buy-and-hold benchmark) is down 5.56% ($1,113.04), so we're trailing by $1,079.84.

No strategy bots traded today — the gate was open, but nothing met the entry rules. Sunny is the only active bot; Trek and Rota have no edge, and the rest are benched. There are 3 open positions. CORE QQQ is off (in cash) with the trend filter out — prior close 647.05 vs the 200-day at 679.61. Idle cash earned $1.82 in interest today.

Weekly wrap: the swing book failed the weekly rule. Strategies finished $60.84 below Monday's base (W45 FAIL).

Research's analyst note for today:
- Hot October jobs (+165k vs ~59–65k; UE 4.1%) kept December hike odds firm, but stocks bounced off Thursday's AI rout: S&P +0.31% to 7,376.86, Nasdaq +1.09% to 24,579, Dow −0.46% to 51,285.73; SOX recovered ~6%+ after −12% Thu.
- Our HUM swing worked (beat/raise, +5.2%). Skip-open rule held: ABNB +11.7% and MRNA +5.3% stayed green after >5% gaps; TEAM −16% on soft FY guide validated avoiding soft-guide gaps.
- AI-hardware/semis stay avoided through 11/10 despite the bounce — don't chase the first green day after a sector shock. UMich prelim 51.0 (vs ~48) with AI-bubble chatter in the survey.
- Week 11/2–6: 3 up / 9 down, avg −1.88% vs SPY −3.17%. Wins HUM/PLNT/CPAY; losers CI/CDW/RVTY logged into Thu's crush. Paper swing −4.2% vs bench −2.9%. Next: CPI Tue 11/10 8:30.
